suspicion: A raw-418 maximum change and a later resource gain/drain in the same program quote against stale maxima (projection tracks only balances)
why_rejected: resource_policy_boundary ends the segment after any maximum-resource-affecting aura mutation; the suffix is quoted after commit (MUT-R2-005).

suspicion: Active raw-396 fresh application fires its child when the pool already satisfies the threshold, unlike a crossing-only consumer
why_rejected: Trinity AuraEffect::HandleTriggerSpellOnPowerAmount casts on REAL apply when power >= amount (gain) / <= amount (loss) (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5394-5419); crossing predicate equals Unit::TriggerOnPowerChangeAuras (Unit.cpp:10144-10152); refresh (no REAL mode) does not re-fire, as Core's Reapplied fresh=false.

suspicion: Power Drain drops the caster energize half of the effect
why_rejected: Admitted Power Drain requires NEUTRAL amount facts (amplitude 0); Trinity's gain is int32(drained * amplitude) = 0 (MUT-R2-006).

suspicion: Active raw-418 recomputation drops the construction-time passive flat/percentage maximum stage
why_rejected: Runtime pools are seeded from PassiveMaximumResourceStage initial_maximum (flat-adjusted) and factor (maximum_resource_modifier.rs:134-147) and project (initial + deltas) * factor, the same (base+flat)*pct order as construction (resource.rs:220-248) and Trinity TOTAL_VALUE then TOTAL_PCT.

suspicion: Expansiveness construction-only maximum is lost when an active raw-418 aura recomputes Astral Power
why_rejected: Expansiveness stages return the adjusted maximum as initial_maximum with factor 1.0 (passive_maximum_resource/expansiveness.rs:67-137).

suspicion: Resist Silence (19786) is read from the caster of Curse of Suppression rather than the victim
why_rejected: The resisted-mechanic lookup uses the impact target index (state/modifiers.rs:223-225), the holder of 19786; Trinity reads victim->GetMechanicResistChance in the miss/resist roll. Defense None disables resist in both.

suspicion: Raw-245 dispel-duration floors 0.75*duration while Trinity AddPct truncates the negative delta (rounds up)
why_rejected: The admitted applicand duration is exactly 3000 ms and mechanic duration is neutral for it, so 3000*75/100 = 2250 in both; the rounding difference is unobservable at the admitted slice.

suspicion: Slaughter the Weak Bleed-state condition is caster-specific or ignores other Bleed auras
why_rejected: Marker match accepts any source (modifier.rs:639-656), matching Trinity's non-per-caster AURA_STATE_BLEED; every other selected aura with a Bleed mechanic is rejected at compile (target_aura_state_modifier.rs:236-258).

suspicion: Raw-286 recovery rate lacks Trinity's max(amount, -99) clamp
why_rejected: rate_factor clamps the speed at 0.01 (cooldown_recovery_rate.rs:850-852), identical to 100/(max(amount,-99)+100) inverted; per-effect factors multiply as in SpellHistory.cpp:443-446.

suspicion: Engine::reset leaves prepared aura observations holding state from the previous iteration
why_rejected: PreparedAuraObservations is only borrowed immutably after construction (engine/src/lib.rs:662, 967); observations Vec is cleared by reset.

suspicion: Passive absorb-received factor admits a negative multiplier or double counting
why_rejected: Role policy AtLeastNegativeHundred (selected_trait_package.rs:717-722) bounds the factor at >= 0, the selected rank amount is consumed (passive_absorb_received.rs:189-201), and the state authority admits exactly one Player binding.

suspicion: White main-hand period is not rescaled when haste changes mid-swing
why_rejected: The admitted white program has no active haste authority (period frozen from passive haste at admission, white_swing/runtime.rs:52-62; white_idle.rs:51-117), so no mid-swing haste change is constructible.

suspicion: RandomStream ordered_outcome/uniform_index skip or bias draws
why_rejected: ordered_outcome skips only when the first positive probability is certain or all are zero, else one shared draw with clamped cumulative thresholds; uniform_index uses Lemire rejection with threshold 2^64 mod n; next_unit_f64 is 53-bit exact.
